# Telegram Web A transport provenance

- Source: https://github.com/Ajaxy/telegram-tt
- Commit: `e58cca34018903452a812dff2dfa5cee238ebc18`
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

Only the GramJS transport, cryptography, session, and generated TL schema code
is vendored. TeleVecha does not use Web A's update manager, application state,
database, draft handling, or UI.
